name: Abdul Rahman Al-Harbi
bio: With over 15 years in the transport industry, Abdul Rahman founded Falak Ride to provide premium, reliable transport for pilgrims visiting the holy cities.

name: Khalid Al-Otaibi
bio: Khalid oversees daily operations and ensures every ride meets our high standards of safety, comfort, and punctuality.

name: Saud Al-Ghamdi
bio: Saud manages our diverse fleet, ensuring every vehicle is maintained to the highest standards for your comfort and safety.

name: Faisal Al-Qahtani
bio: Faisal leads our customer support team, available 24/7 to assist with bookings, questions, and any travel needs.
